title: SSE egress pipeline with bounded buffers, backpressure and real cancellation

pytest_full_offline_suite.note: full gateway_v2 offline suite at the task-17 final verification gate; no regressions

ast_gate_clis.rule: every AST gate CLI exits 0 (no capacity literal outside runtime/resources.py; no module-level mutable; frozen value types; HTTP objects only in edge/resolve; no tenant-scale leak)

correctness_properties.idiom: seeded random.Random loop >= 10000 iterations (no hypothesis dependency), async via asyncio.run

LGW12-1_memory_plateau.shape: N in-process streams; total buffered <= active_streams * stream_buffer_bytes(active_streams) at every observation point; buffered memory does not grow with stream length

LGW12-7_both_sdk_conformance.shape: in-process ASGI transport; recorded-frame checks for data: [DONE] terminal marker, Error_Frame shape, split-surrogate decoding

harness_note: all clocks, RNGs, scanners and provider sockets are injected; the provider is StubProviderClient (in-process, no socket); every property runs under a seeded random.Random so results are deterministic and not sensitive to CI wall-clock jitter
known_benign_warning: R2-09 'coroutine BudgetLease._refill was never awaited' (undrained single-flight refill coroutines in the budget-lease property tests) — unrelated to GW12, carried from the GW06 card, not a failure
